question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank. **

The villagers kept the ______ out, to collect the rainwater.
solution: The correct answer is **"cruse."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"cruse"** means a small container for holding liquids, usually oil or vinegar. (तरल पदार्थ (जैसे पानी या तेल) रखने के लिए एक छोटा बर्तन (जैसे जार या बर्तन)) • **Example:** *A **cruse**__ of water and a loaf of bread, with cruel mockery, were placed in the recess.* • In the given context, the villagers kept the **"cruse"** out to collect rainwater, indicating that they used a small container to collect the water. • This is a homonym question, where the word **"cruse"** is spelt and pronounced differently from other options, which have different meanings. • The correct answer is Option 2. ​ **Correct sentence:** *The villagers kept the __**cruse**__ out, to collect the rainwater.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Crus"** refers to a medieval military expedition, usually against non-Christians. (एक मध्ययुगीन सैन्य अभियान, आमतौर पर गैर-ईसाइयों के खिलाफ) • **"Crews"** refers to a group of people working together, especially on a ship or aircraft. (एक साथ काम करने वाले लोगों का समूह, विशेषकर जहाज़ या विमान पर) • **"Cruise"** refers to a leisurely journey by sea or land, usually for pleasure. (आमतौर पर आनंद के लिए समुद्र या ज़मीन से इत्मीनान से की गई यात्रा) 1aa:Tbee, The correct answer is **"All the pastries had been eaten by the workers before the day broke."**
